summary: A mixed legal and retail day, highlighted by an Allahabad High Court ruling on workplace dress codes, potential NCLT escalation of the Tata Sons-Trusts dispute, and Starbucks' Chennai expansion with 800 jobs.

bullets.text: Allahabad High Court rules employers cannot force employees to wear Santa caps at workplace.
Tata Trusts led by Noel Tata preparing to challenge N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman; dispute may escalate to NCLT or Bombay High Court.
Starbucks plans Chennai global capability centre creating 800 new jobs.
RBI sold Rs 250 billion bonds with cut-off yields below market estimates, signalling strong demand despite rate hike bets.
Government asks Microsoft to build data centres near power generation sites rather than coastal cable landing hubs.
